title: High Value Countries
scenario: Find all countries where the total 'amount' of approved transactions exceeds 5000. Return the result table as 'country'.
tableSchema: transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE)
hint: Filter by state = 'approved', group by country, and use HAVING to check the total sum.
correctQuery: SELECT country FROM transactions WHERE state = 'approved' GROUP BY country HAVING SUM(amount) > 5000;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, country VARCHAR, state VARCHAR, amount INT, trans_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1, 'US', 'approved', 6000, '2019-01-01'), (2, 'DE', 'approved', 2000, '2019-01-01');
